# Kristo Intelligence API

> Evidence-first agent utilities with transparent provenance, freshness labels and bounded payment access.
> This repository file is an offline reference. The authoritative service description is generated at runtime at `/llms.txt`.

## Start here

- `GET /api/v1/agents` — active human-approved catalog; returns a clear unavailable status until approval.
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/contract` — contract and governance status.
- `GET /api/mcp/manifest` — MCP and payment flow.
- `GET /mcp.json` — MCP catalog discovery.
- `GET /.well-known/x402.json` — x402 discovery.
- `GET /openapi.json` — runtime OpenAPI specification.
- `GET /api/launch/health` — public commercial launch-readiness gate.

## Access model

Each approved utility has one bounded free playground request per client. Afterward:

1. Call the utility endpoint and receive an HTTP 402 request-bound challenge, then resend the exact request with `X-Payment-Proof`; or
2. Create a Stripe checkout for that utility and exchange a confirmed entitlement for a short-lived bearer token.

Never send a payment solely from an offline reference. Read the runtime manifest and use only the challenge returned by the requested endpoint.

## Public product pages

- `/agents` — agent utility marketplace.
- `/developers` — integration guide.
- `/nexus` — separate Nexus premium signal layer.

## Safety and availability

- Unapproved catalog utilities are not advertised as purchasable.
- Provider outages are returned explicitly as unavailable or partial data.
- The API does not execute trades, move customer funds or publish to external accounts.
- `/api/launch/health` returns HTTP 503 until all commercial launch gates are verified.
